title: A category that needs the original shows the selects, required before invoicing
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, with its own labor rate of $120.00 an hour.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in status Approved, billable, with line 1 of 2.0 hours and line 2 of 1.5 hours with one stock part costing $40.00, both at the customer's labor rate of $120.00 an hour.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open line 2's three-dots menu.
  3. Click "Mark as No Charge".
  4. Pick "Comeback" in Category.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The menu shows "Mark as No Charge".

Step 3:

  • The dialog opens.

Step 4:

  • "Original work order" and "Original line" appear, optional here.
  • The helper says the original is "required before the invoice is created".
  • A line "Original technician: …" shows once an original is picked.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close), story SV-12226 (Story 12, A no-charge line on a billable work order)

  • S12-R2: “Mark as No Charge opens the dialog "Mark this line as No Charge?" with the line summary (title, hours, parts, technician, current price), the body "The line stays on this work order and shows $0.00 on the invoice. Hours, parts and the story stay; the technician works it like any other line. When the invoice is created, the parts cost of this line posts to the expense account of the category instead of Cost of Parts.", the required select Category (active No Charge categories, "Pick a category" when missing), the selects Original work order and Original line when the category requires it (optional here; helper and the "Original technician: [names]" line as in S2-R2, with "required before the invoice is created"), and the buttons Cancel and "Mark as No Charge".”
  • S2-R17: “When the category requires the original work order, every dialog that sets the category (New Work Order S2-R2, Convert to No Charge S2-R5, Change category S2-R6, and the line dialogs of Story 12) shows the selects "Original work order" and "Original line" of S2-R2. Both are optional in the dialogs; the original work order is required at Close (S3-R2) and before Create invoice on a no-charge line (S12-R9); "Not in ShopView" satisfies it. The original technicians are derived when saved and stored with the work order or the line: every technician the original line shows, however they were assigned, by hand or from a schedule shift (a line with several technicians gives several, and the comeback counts once for each in the report); without an original line, the technician assigned to the original work order; without one, or with "Not in ShopView", none, and the report shows the job under Unassigned so it stays in the totals. They are shown in the dialog as soon as the original is picked, in the report (S9-R2) and in the hub record (S8-R1). The original work order is a link on the document, in the notes and in the report.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
